features: Weatherproof NVR system: 8-channel NVR with built-in 8-port PoE switch in a NEMA Type 3R 5052 aluminum enclosure with 10" LCD monitor, thermostat-controlled 118mm fan and 6-outlet 120V AC power strip
Up to 8TB internal storage in total
Includes CMS software (view up to 64 cameras); remote access with Optiview VMS and mobile apps
notes: Values come from the WPNVR8A spec sheet. The linked product page now describes the WPNVR8-LCD, built around an embedded NVR8P8-2, and its values are not used here.
Maximum resolution conflict between official sources: the spec sheet lists recording resolutions up to 5MP, the product page title gives 8MP. max_camera_mp left out.
Enclosure outside dimensions 19" x 19" x 12" (H x W x D); system weight 41 lb.
